title: Voice replies: speak bot answers while listening, hands-free stop
description:
Second voice slice (docs/VOICE.md section 4). Browser speechSynthesis (no download, no cost). While listening is on, the bot's reply in the open conversation (and a failed turn's reason) is spoken, cleaned of markdown/links/code and capped with 'The rest is on screen.' While speaking, only stop/quiet/stop talking are acted on (no self-triggered sends); iOS speech is unlocked by the mic tap.

Feature: Hearing teammates' replies
  Scenario: A reply in the open conversation is spoken while listening
  Scenario: Markdown, links and code are not read aloud
  Scenario: A long reply is cut short with a pointer to the screen
  Scenario: A failed turn's reason is spoken
  Scenario: Saying stop while a reply is spoken stops speaking
  Scenario: While a reply is spoken, other speech is ignored
  Scenario: Nothing is spoken when listening is off
right_now_summary: Browser speech now reads cleaned bot replies and errors while listening, with stop commands silencing speech.
